name: CDirective Bot
description: Telegram chat agent fronted by the OpenClaw gateway. Streams Claude responses back to the chat user and can invoke registered OpenClaw skills mid-turn. High sensitivity because it bridges a public messaging surface to the model gateway.

skills.name: Chat Respond
skills.description: Generates a streaming chat response to an inbound telegram message.

skills.name: Tool Invoke
skills.description: Invokes a registered OpenClaw skill during a chat turn and returns the result inline.

skills.name: Stream Response
skills.description: Streams tokens back to the telegram channel as the model produces them.
